item.title: #23 Iowa to face #14 Vanderbilt in the Reliaquest Bowl
item.description: UI Athletics news release IOWA CITY, Iowa — The 23rd-ranked University of Iowa football team will face No. 14 Vanderbilt in the 2025 Reliaquest Bowl on Dec. 31, in Tampa, Florida. Kickoff is set for 11 a.m. (CT)
